options.reason: The table is evidently assembled to relate physicochemical wine measurements to sensory quality ratings, and quality is a discrete 7-level grade (3-9), so multiclass classification of quality from the chemistry features is the natural task. Color is a legitimate sample attribute usable as a feature, and no column is a recode of quality or known only after it (density is an independent physicochemical measurement, not derived from the rating).
options.title: multiclass

options.reason: Because the seven quality levels are ordered grades, a numeric regression on quality is an equally defensible framing of the same assembled task; MAE is the appropriate override metric for an ordinal count-like target.
options.title: regression
